about: The Intern's lines for the stream and the site: one cue per feed event (01 section 10, with 1.4's reward events) and per refusal code (01 section 7). Text only; the stream turns `intern` lines into speech and shows `system` lines as Stamp's caption. Voice: spec 24.14. The Intern: first person, short, earnest, a little anxious, office words for bad news, never brags, never talks prices or advice, at most one joke and always on itself. The contract: no person, no feelings; code, rank, limit, asked, with units; no adjectives, no exclamation marks. A line is chosen by the event's seq (seq modulo the number of lines), so the stream and the site say the same thing for the same event. Placeholders in braces are filled by stream/cues.ts; amounts are already formatted ("$11.49").

{goal_word} filled, level {level}. There's a sticker for that.

{right} of you guessed right this round. I'm as surprised as anyone.

{right} of you saw that coming. I'd like to say I did too.

intern: Three rounds, three refusals of my own answer. That's three strikes: the program has {strike_word} me. Fair.

intern: The brake is off. My usual limits are back from round {round_id}.
